title: The chord between two distinct, non-antipodal unit vectors stays in the closed unit ball and meets every line through 0 at most once (parent steps 1–2)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let a, b ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P) with |a| = |b| = 1, a ≠ b and b ≠ −a. Then there are ℓ ∈ ℝ and u ∈ ℝ^P such that ℓ > 0, |a − b| = ℓ, |u| = 1, b + ℓu = a, |b + su| ≤ 1 for every s ∈ [0, ℓ], and, for every e ∈ ℝ^P and s₁, s₂, t₁, t₂ ∈ ℝ, b + s₁u = t₁e and b + s₂u = t₂e imply s₁ = s₂ (the line s ↦ b + su meets each line ℝe through 0 in at most one parameter).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a b : Euclid P), ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖b‖ = 1 → a ≠ b → b ≠ -a → ∃ (ℓ : ℝ) (u : Euclid P), 0 < ℓ ∧ ‖a - b‖ = ℓ ∧ ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ b + ℓ • u = a ∧ (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) ℓ, ‖b + s • u‖ ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ (e : Euclid P) (s₁ s₂ t₁ t₂ : ℝ), b + s₁ • u = t₁ • e → b + s₂ • u = t₂ • e → s₁ = s₂
